_doc: Short 9:16 Track Pacing Standard v4.0 (strictly vertical 1080x1920, 1.7-2.5 min). Empirically calibrated against 28 SCRIPT_YOUTUBE reference Shorts (median 595w, 4.59 eff. wps [4.52-4.71], 19.6-22.0% RMS pauses, 2.98 s/shot). CI REJECTS sluggish <4.42 wps AND rushed >4.74 wps.

voice._why: Hard CI corridor [4.42, 4.74] locks actual output tightly around the 4.59 wps YouTube reference median. Inter-segment pause_share [5%, 14%] combines with 0.15s intra-sentence gaps and natural 0.18s breath pauses to yield ~20% real RMS pause breathing.

episode._why: Concise 1.6-2.5 minute vertical Short (sweet spot 500-620 words -> ~110-136 s at 4.57 overall wps).

episode_long._doc: OPT-IN extended vertical Short (needs script.json length='long' + brief.md '## Length override' user_quote).

shots._why: Snappy yet breathable 9:16 cutting pace matching ref median 2.98 s/shot (20.1 shots/min) with 2-4 deliberate visual hold beats.
